name: G-III Apparel Group, Ltd.
summary: G-III Apparel Group, Ltd. designs, sources, and markets women's and men's apparel in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Wholesale Operations and Retail Operations. The company offers outerwear, dresses, sportswear, swimwear, women's suits, performance wear, suit separates, athleisure, jeans, handbags, footwear, accessories, small leather goods, cold weather accessories, and luggage. It markets apparel and other products under the its owned brands, including Andrew Marc, DKNY, Donna Karan, Eliza J, G.H.
